source_full_text: There lived a community of cats in a deserted house they had taken possession of not far from a large town. They had everything they could possibly desire for their comfort, they were well fed and well lodged, and if by any chance an unlucky mouse was stupid enough to venture in their way, they caught it, not to eat it,

reference_text: 在离一座大城市不远的一所废弃房子里，住着一群猫。它们占据了这所房子，拥有了一切可能使它们感到舒适的东西，食物充足，住处安适。如果偶尔有只倒霉的老鼠愚蠢到敢闯入它们的领地，它们就会抓住它，但并不是为了吃掉它。
